{{Quote|You can't be thinking of traveling on one of ''those''.|Princess Leia Organa referring to lily pads|<ref name="SotME" />}}
'''Lily pads''', also known as '''lilies''' or '''pads''', were a large [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] found on the large underground lakes within [[Coway shaft]]s on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. They were capable of remaining afloat while supporting the weight of several [[Human/Legends|humans]].<ref name="SotME" />
